explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain why the objective drops from 1000.0 in the original run to 200.0 even though the final total-ownership imbalance is still `diff_total = 1000.0`. Your answer must name the exact new code variables and constraint families that make this possible—especially the immediate/deferred split (`x_immediate_s1[i]`, `x_immediate_s2[i]`, `x_deferred[i]`), the weighted objective variable `tax_weighted_diff`, and at least one of the new business-rule constraints tied to `son1_min_share`, `max_high_value_items_per_son`, or `deferred_diamonds_per_son`—and trace each back to the exact `general_parameters.csv` field names and the `table_1.csv` columns used to instantiate them. Also use the solver diagnostics to identify which imbalance component is binding in the revised optimum, interpret the marginal meaning of the LP-relaxation reduced costs/duals for `diff_immediate` and `diff_total`, and explain why you cannot linearly extrapolate those marginal values to predict the MIP objective change under tighter share or diamond limits.
